title: A Light for Wrackholm
description: Wrackholm's beacon, the Wrack Light, has been dark since the Snuffing, and nobody on the island has answered a horn since.

stages.text: Nobody on Wrackholm has answered a horn since the Snuffing. The yard is dark, the Wrack Light out on the Teeth is dark, and the answering horn by the lane-house door, which Oda says has answered every boat that ever came home here, is lashed shut. Go up and ask who lashed it.

Wenna Garrow, the lane-warden, won't unlash the horn while the Wrack Light is dark: a horn answered is a lane promised, and the Teeth are out there in the fog. The Wrack Light stands on its stack out on the Teeth. At the bottom of a spring tide, she says, the Teeth come up enough to walk, if you know where to put your feet. She knew, once. The tide isn't down.
